title: Signature
description: Detached, scheme-agile proof over EPR canonical bytes. Source of truth: EPR atom, self-notarized via content-address (CIDv1 dag-cbor sha256) + a signature envelope. Canonical CBOR bytes + detached signature is the authoritative form. Category A — notarized; notarization mechanism is content-derived CID + signer proof (not DHT). The envelope carries the scheme code, the signer's key as canonical multikey bytes (unsigned-varint codec ‖ key) and the signature; the signed transcript is domain ‖ u16be(epoch) ‖ u16be(scheme) ‖ key ‖ body (elohim/epr/src/signature.rs). Unknown schemes are structurally admissible so a reader can HOLD them rather than reject them as malformed; scheme 0 is strict Ed25519 with a 34-byte multikey (ed 01 ‖ 32) and a 64-byte signature. JSON wire format: CIDs serialize as integer arrays (byte representation of the CIDv1 binary form, via the cid crate serde-codec feature); key and sig serialize as integer arrays, produced by serde_bytes (byte strings in CBOR).

signer.description: CIDv1 of the issuer's Agent EPR, serialized as a byte array (serde-codec feature of the cid crate).

scheme.description: Signature scheme code. 0 = strict Ed25519. Any other code is carried and HELD by a reader that does not implement it.

key.description: The signer's public key as canonical multikey bytes (minimal unsigned-varint codec, then the key).
